nodes_source.source_quote: The simulation parameters regarding driving behaviors are calibrated based on empirical data.
nodes_source.description: Real-world traffic data from the freeway connecting Qingdao and Huangdao, used to calibrate simulation parameters for the SUMO environment.
nodes_source.reproducibility_rationale: The Data Availability statement explicitly states that the data used to support the study's results are available from the corresponding author upon request, with no public link provided.

nodes_process.source_quote: On average, the DRL method reduces vehicle travel time by 13% when compared with the no-control scenario.
nodes_process.description: Final outcome: DRL reduces average vehicle travel time by 13% compared to no-control. Initial logic and parameters are validated for SUMO environment.

nodes_process.source_quote: Three consecutive frames of the traffic video in the controlled area are needed as the observation input
The episode reward and mean travel time are both converged in 400,000 training frames
A perturbation analysis is conducted to evaluate the impact of information contained in video data.
nodes_process.description: Direct leap to final spatial masking evaluation. Information of different subareas is removed.
